name: Barbed Wire
description: This spiky paint will protect your gear from unwanted visitors, while you're recovering your tank's strength after another round of tiresome battles.
interestingFacts: This paint was added into the game on 30th October 2018, as part of the 2018 Halloween celebrations. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
Barbed Wire was given to all players who got 700 or more Stars during the Star Hunt event that took place October 30 - November 5, 2018.
